parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states that the authors need to add some description to address the issue of unmentioned hyperparameters. The action is directly stated: "the authors need to add some description." The comment also identifies what the description should cover: the other node2vec hyperparameters besides C that were not swept, and the concern that their default values may not work best across the datasets. Thus the authors are given concrete direction about the content of the added description, namely reporting and justifying settings for the unmentioned hyperparameters rather than only C. Because the comment explicitly names the action and concretely specifies what the added description must contain, this satisfies the rubric criterion of an explicit action with concrete details on what to implement.
